metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for EVE Online players, backed by the EVE-Cyno data service.

plugins.name: eve-cyno
plugins.description: EVE Online data tools over MCP: fit validation and stats, ship and module facts, live market prices, industry, routes, system search, jump distances, jump-drive planning, market history, Thera connections, LP store offers, mission agents, skill plans, build costs, planetary chains. No API key needed for the public tools; a free key adds battle reports, free-text fit search and higher limits.
